title: Schizophrenia, schizoaffective and bipolar disorder
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's psychiatric condition.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for mental health.

HPI
Pt is a 75-year-old female presenting for routine psychiatric follow-up. Pt currently has a diagnosis of paranoid schizophrenia. She reports feeling stable and has been compliant with her long-acting injectable (LAI) medication. No reports of acute distress or behavioral changes since last visit.

Medication List
- Long-acting injectable antipsychotic (LAI) - every 4 weeks
- Multivitamin - daily

Exam
Gen: Well-appearing, alert and oriented x3.
Psych: Speech is coherent and goal-directed. Mood is stable; affect is congruent. Thought process is linear. No acute distress noted.
Vitals: BP 128/82, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F.

Assessment
1. Paranoid schizophrenia: Pt remains stable on current LAI regimen. No acute decompensation noted today.

Plan
- Continue current LAI medication.
- Maintain current treatment plan.
- Follow up in 3 months.

Electronically signed,
E. Castillo, DO
10/14/2026

distractors.why: Schizophrenia is documented, not schizoaffective disorder.
